note: Both sets contain the same five claims with identical values, conditions, and quotes, differing only in minor attribute wording ('force profile' vs 'force trend', 'peak force location' vs 'peak location'). Both correctly bind the 4° pitch to low wind speeds/Region 1.5, the 90 m force peak to below-rated wind speeds, and the outboard 5% drop to the Prandtl tip loss model. Neither invents values or drops conditions, and both omit the same secondary facts (e.g., design-point pitch of 0°, optimal pitch of −1.0°).
